scored_papers.title: A universal time-of-arrival signature of Bose--Einstein condensation
scored_papers.abstract: We show that Bose--Einstein condensation produces a cusp in the time-of-arrival (TOA) statistics of a harmonically trapped gas released into free fall. In the semiclassical long time-of-flight regime, with $\epsilon=\sigma_V/\sqrt{2gH}\ll1$, both the mean and standard deviation of the arrival time distribution, which are governed by the longitudinal velocity variance, remain continuous, but acquire a cusp whose one-sided slope ratio is universal within the ideal-gas far-field limit, $\mathcal{R}_\infty=2.5556\ldots$, and equals the trapped-gas specific-heat ratio $C(Tc^-)/C(Tc^+)$. Finite atom number rounds the cusp and weak interactions perturb it only weakly, leaving a measurable time-domain signature of condensation.
scored_papers.reason: 到着時刻(TOA)統計でBEC転移を普遍的に特定できる！🎯 長時間飛行レジームでTOA分布にカスプが現れ、BEC固有の普遍的シグネチャを形成。到着時刻問題の実験的検証に直結⏱️✨
scored_papers.summary: 調和トラップから解放されたBECのTOA分布を半古典近似で解析。凝縮相転移で縦速度分散のカスプ（非解析性）が発生し、平均・標準偏差の温度依存性に普遍的特異点が現れる🔬
